field_class: canonical semilinear coupled wave PDE in 1+1 with pre-existing V=U+W+Vint
regularity: smooth finite relative-energy data with vanishing boundary flux and local wellposedness
initial: Phi0,Psi0 arbitrary compatible with F=dPhi Vint, G=gradPsi Vint in L2; A=||F||^2>0,B=||G||^2>0; Psi0 nonzero
time_range: exists t0>0 by derivative continuity; no source-independent numerical t0 is asserted
transfer: Ephi decreases and Epsi increases on (0,t0); interaction derivative zero at t=0
composition: two profiles must satisfy same action and compatible total Cauchy boundary/topological class; no two-body term added
